notes.zh-CN: 新增对 Kimi Code CLI 的支持：GrokX 现在可以用 kimi acp 打开会话，和 Grok、OpenCode、CodeBuddy、Antigravity、Codex 一样在新建对话或 Bot 里选择 Kimi。模型（K3 / K3.1 Pro 等）与思考强度（low / high / max）取自 Kimi 自己上报的目录；Kimi 的权限请求照常在聊天里弹出审批，它自己的 mode 选择保持不变。Kimi 只上报上下文占用、不上报词元数，所以用量气泡显示上下文占用环而不是词元合计。粘贴图片同样可用——Kimi 的模型都接受图片输入。
notes.en: This release adds Kimi Code CLI: GrokX can now run a conversation on kimi acp, picked next to Grok, OpenCode, CodeBuddy, Antigravity and Codex when you start a chat or create a Bot. Models (K3, K3.1 Pro, …) and thinking levels (low / high / max) come from the catalog Kimi reports; its permission requests show up in the chat as usual while Kimi's own mode picker is left alone. Kimi reports how full the context is but no token counts, so the usage pill shows a context ring instead of a token total. Pasting images works too — every Kimi model accepts them.
